title: Export-share: vector filename keeps @2x
goal: On the export screen, choosing a format that has no pixel size still leaves a 2x size suffix in the suggested filename, which promises something the file will not have. This drops the suffix when it does not apply.
notes: Objective: design-system > clickthrough-sweep. From study-tasks.json fix-export-share-scale. Verified still live 2026-08-22: picking SVG or PDF disables the scale seg but the scale variable stays 2, so filename() renders launch-poster@2x.svg. Reset scale to 1 (or exclude suffix for vector formats) when a vector format is picked.
acceptance: Choosing a resolution-independent format shows a suggested filename with no size suffix
Switching back to a pixel format restores the previously chosen size and its suffix
